thread:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — Horizon (prospect) sent an RFI and needs a combined capability matrix, security questionnaire answers, and a concrete POC timeline + pricing. They want an appendix with network/arch diagrams and HSM details. Can we split ownership?

Evan Ortiz: I can own the security questionnaire and diagrams. They specifically asked about BYOK + HSM integration and KMS/HSM options for Private. Do we have a standard answer for 'on-prem HSM vs cloud KMS'?

Sophie Patel: I'll take pricing and the POC commercial proposal. Quick decision: do we propose a 1-month pilot or a 3-month reserved POC for capacity estimates? 3-month gives better pricing but they might push for short trials.

Kim (sales-eng): I'll draft the capability matrix. Please drop feature list items they care about into this thread — I saw latency SLA, model pinning, audit logs, VPC/private control plane, and quantization support on their checklist.

Maya Chen: @Sophie propose 3-month Reserved POC with a short option to scale down after month 1. We should call out 'estimate' ranges. @Evan can you pull our standard private deployment diagram (VPC peering + transit, HSM placement)? Need it attached to RFI PDF.

Evan Ortiz: Pulling diagrams now. Also pinging infra about HSM certs and whether we can support customer-managed HSM (HSM-on-customer-prem) vs cloud KMS with HSM-backed keys. ETA tomorrow AM.

deploy-bot: New file uploaded by Evan Ortiz: https://drive.redwood/horizon/rfi/arch-vpc-hsm-v2.pdf :file_folder: (public to team)

Sophie Patel: Ballpark numbers to start (will refine):
- Dedicated POC (4xA100 equiv): $28k/mo (estimate)
- Private package (deployment + 1 wk onsite + packaging): $45k one-time
- Optional HSM integration support: $8k one-time
I'll format into a short table for the pricing slide.

Kim (sales-eng): Draft capability matrix snippet (csv) — dropping here for quick review, will convert to table for the RFI:
```
feature,supported,notes
Latency SLA,Partial,90th perc SLA for hosted; dedicated SLA available for committed pools
Model pinning,Yes,Version pinning + rollout controls supported
KMS/HSM,Yes,Cloud KMS + customer BYOK + integration guide for on-prem HSM
Private control plane,Yes,VPC + private proxy + audit logs
KV/prefix caching,Yes,Configurable per-route
Quantization support,Yes,Recommendations per workload in Optimize
```

Maya Chen: Nice. For the security questionnaire: they asked for SOC2 status, pen test cadence, and FedRAMP readiness. @Legal - Nora, can you provide language on FedRAMP timeline and contract phrasing for security controls?

Legal - Nora: For RFI, state: "Security program: SOC2 Type II in place; annual penetration testing; FedRAMP readiness in roadmap (evaluation started, expected program timeline 6–9 months)." Avoid firm delivery dates. For contract-level asks around indemnities/HSM custody we should escalate, but for RFI keep it high-level.

Evan Ortiz: Adding specific HSM answer: we support customer-managed keys with cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS/Azure Key Vault) backed by HSM; for fully air-gapped on-prem HSM we provide an integration guide and an install support package. I'll attach the HSM integration doc.

deploy-bot: New file uploaded by Evan Ortiz: https://drive.redwood/horizon/rfi/hsm-integration-guide.pdf :file_folder:

Sophie Patel: Updated pricing draft attached: https://drive.redwood/horizon/rfi/pricing-estimate-v1.xlsx — includes committed vs on-demand rows and an optional add-on for security hardening workshops.

Kim (sales-eng): Two quick asks before I finalize the matrix: 1) Confirm which models they care about (open Llama-derivative vs gpt-compat). 2) Confirm target latency (p50/p90) for their workflow.

Maya Chen: I sent them a clarifying email — they replied pref that model family is 'open foundation models' and target p90 ~ 150ms for chat-like inference.

Sophie Patel: I'll reflect that in the cost (lower latency targets increase instance needs). Going to produce a one-page RFI bundle (capability matrix + short answers + attachments) by EOD tomorrow.

Maya Chen: Great. Owners recap: Evan = security questionnaire + diagrams + HSM doc; Sophie = pricing + POC commercial language; Kim = capability matrix & technical answers; Legal Nora = FedRAMP/security boilerplate. I'll assemble and send to Horizon once we have Evan's final HSM wording and the pricing sheet. Thanks all! :thumbsup:

Evan Ortiz: Got it — will push final docs by 09:00 tomorrow.

Legal - Nora: I'll drop a short contract caveats paragraph into the draft before you send, Maya.

Maya Chen: Perfect. If anyone needs to attach additional test/eval logs or perf runs, drop them in the drive folder and @me.

Kim (sales-eng): Will do. Adding a short note in the matrix about fallback policies and canary rollouts.

Sophie Patel: Quick FYI — include a line about billing: POC invoiced up front for first month, remainder on net-30 unless they sign reserved commit.

Maya Chen: Noted. Closing loop tomorrow after final docs come in.
